original:
क्रियेशिवाय शब्दज्ञान। तें केवळ विडंबन।
अनुभवेंविण सांगणें। व्यर्थ जाय॥
sanskrit:
क्रियेशिवाय शब्दज्ञान। तें केवळ विडंबन।
अनुभवेंविण सांगणें। व्यर्थ जाय॥
transliteration:
kriyeśivāya śabdajñāna | teṃ kevaḷa viḍaṃbana |
anubhaveṃviṇa sāṃgaṇeṃ | vyartha jāya ||
translation: Intellectual verbal knowledge divorced from practical action is mere mockery. Teaching others without personal realization is entirely futile.
meaning: Dashaka 11: Siddha Lakshana (Characteristics of the Enlightened Worker)

layers.author: samarth-ramdas
layers.content: कृतीविना केवळ शब्दांचे ज्ञान हे निव्वळ व्यर्थ आहे. स्वतःच्या अनुभवाशिवाय दुसऱ्याला शिकवणे निरुपयोगी ठरते.

layers.author: warkari-scholars
layers.content: One of Samarth Ramdas's most iconic aphorisms: integrity requires complete harmony between speech and action. Spiritual philosophy must be lived in real conduct.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: आचरण के बिना केवल शब्दों का ज्ञान उपहास का कारण बनता है। बिना प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव के उपदेश देना व्यर्थ है।
